column1: # Generated by `lake exe oracle gen` (spec/Oracle.lean) from the definition in
# spec/Aontu: what evaluation singles out, `Output`, on literals, preferences
# and disjunctions with their ranks, maps and lists with defaults and spreads,
# and meets of these, as `gens` rows whose expectation is the JSON of the
# value `output` gives, which `output_iff` makes the definition's own. A value
# that singles out nothing has no row until P5 names its class. Each row runs
# evaluation on a document with the one key `v`.
# Regenerate with `make spec`; never edit by hand. The cases the ports do
# not yet answer this way are listed in spec/ledger.tsv.
# Variables, each the value both runners bind for every row, follow in rows
# i0 on, read as names the calling program declares.
# Path values follow in rows k0 on: path(p) generates its own address, two
# meet by the prefix rule, the longer winning, and path admits each. A string
# constraint reads an address by its spelling, in rows ks0 on.
# Lists that hold a marked element follow in rows gl0 on, read as a document
# reads them: the list holds no position for the element.
# Numbers at so many significant digits follow in rows gs0 on:
# Numbers at so many places, at both counts, and as strings follow in rows gw0
# on: `Number.rounded` and `Number.written`, in the same module.
# What a document writes under its output annotations follows in rows wa0 on:
# `outputW` (spec/Aontu/Writing.lean), each value written by the record it
# carries, a number rounded or as text, a boolean as a number or its name, a
# string in a case, an address in a form, a map's keys in a style, and a value
# written empty left out under empty: "omit".
